questions.question: Is the baseline intentionally weak?
questions.finding: No. Supplied recommended curves are unchanged; area-share commissioning improves the network. No AI comparison exists.

questions.question: Does it use current outdoor conditions sensibly?
questions.finding: Yes. Piecewise-linear outdoor reset and pump schedules, recalculated at actual 30-minute boundaries.

questions.question: Does it heat more when colder?
questions.finding: Yes. Raw supply/pump curves are monotonic; Cold Wave actions and delivered heat are measured.

questions.question: Does it back off when warmer?
questions.finding: Yes. Raw targets fall; applied values follow only documented slew and interval constraints.

questions.question: Does it use reasonable fixed commissioning?
questions.finding: Yes. Static area shares at 45 Hz, limiting valve 85%, practical 5pp rounding; valves fixed at 50/60/85%.

questions.question: Does it violate comfort simply to save energy?
questions.finding: No energy minimisation is performed. Normal comfort is 0% and overheating 67.10%, disclosed as a real limitation of these curves with the heterogeneous accepted building fixture, not an energy-saving target.

questions.question: Was it tuned using stress scenarios?
questions.finding: No. Normal and Cold Wave were evaluated before the three stress families; no breakpoint was changed using any scenario.

questions.question: Does it use future information?
questions.finding: No. Controller signature admits only timestamp/current outdoor/self state; paired differing-future tests prove identical actions.

questions.question: Is an arbitrary delay added?
questions.finding: No. Only 30-minute updates, frozen slew limits, accepted FIFO transit and building inertia.

questions.question: Is AI logic hidden inside it?
questions.finding: No. No predictor, optimiser, indoor/solar feedback or forbidden dependency is present.
